answer: A velvet rope guards entry: an identity earns standing only after trading with 12 unrelated counterparties over 10 epochs, each deal leaving a public thread. A newcomer may wander in freely, but its votes stay locked until its web is wide enough. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 real trades at 5 tokens each, 60,000 tokens sunk, and the ring still clusters and gets flagged. An honest agent pays once, builds real partners, and keeps full rewards.
